post.description: Send a text message with the Flow REST API.

parameters.name: {threadId}
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the thread

parameters.name: sync
parameters.description: Indicates that this message should be processed in sync mode.

parameters.name: writeConcern
parameters.description: Indicates that this message should be processed in writeConcern mode.

traceId.description: Optional unique number that is passed along to identify the message. Use this to verify message delivery.

type.description: Indicates the type of message. Should be `text`

speech.description: The text or speech message to process. The maximum length of a message is 255 characters.

originator.description: Indicates the information about the sender.

profile.description: Optional Profile object. An originator can contain additional profile information using the profile object.

locale.description: Locale code that combines the language and country code for example `en-GB`

metadata.description: The metadata is dynamic in nature and contains key value pairs with additional info. This is optional.

get.description: Fetches a list of messages using the Flow REST API.

parameters.name: sync
parameters.description: Optional parameter for enabling sync mode.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional parameter for pagination

parameters.name: {threadId}
parameters.description: A unique identifier of the thread. This is a required field.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Optional parameter to enable to retrieve the history of triggered events. Default value is `false`

code-samples.code:
GET rest/v1/messages/EXAMPLE-853a-448f-9f91-ef397588ff87?sync=true&page=3&events=true HTTP/1.1
Host: api.flow.ai
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: MY_MESSAGING_API_KEY

post.description: Broadcasts to a mobile subscriber ISDN (MSISDN) number with the Flow REST API.

audience.description: A list of originator objects. The intended audience to whom to send a message to. See the originator format for more details. Either the `phoneNumber` or `identifier` needs to be provided.

channel.description: Information about the Flow integration used to send a message from.

channelName.description: Type of channel to send the message, see the reference table below

externalId.description: Identifier of the channel to send the message, see the table below where to find this.

eventName.description: Mandatory if type is event. This is the name of the [event](ref:trigger-an-event) to trigger

speech.description: Mandatory if type is `text`. Use this to run text classification.

timezone.description: Optional UTC timezone offset to use

post.description: Broadcast to segments with the Flow REST API.

audience.description: The segment to trigger event for. A list of segment objects. Either the `name` or `id` needs to be provided.

name.description: Name of your segment, for example `MY_SEGMENT_1`.

id.description: ID of your segment. Can be obtained [here](ref:get-audience-segments).

eventName.description: Name of the [event](https://community.khoros.com/t5/Triggers-Replies/Trigger-event/ta-p/635479) to trigger. For example, `MY_EVENT`
